options.name: -v
options.description: : Show read/write messages during a replay session.

options.name: -l
options.description:
: Specify libc file path. This is used by several
built-in functions, such as libcFuncAddr.

options.name: -f
options.description:
When this option is given, the replayer will
create a random flag of the given length in the
given local path to test the exploit. This option
is valid only with the stdin command.

options.name: -o
options.description:
: Specify a path to store PoE's output, which is a
return value of PoE's submission (submit block).

options.name: --stream-timeout
options.description:
: Set a timeout for read and write operations when
communicating over a stream (default: 5000ms).
